proof_requirements.identity: Every live receipt must report the exact candidate SHA and actual executing seat.
proof_requirements.journal: Live rows require a bounded, public-safe gateway journal receipt unless the row contract explicitly proves an immutable source-only surface.
proof_requirements.trace: Trace-required rows require public-safe raw Tempo JSON, valid fixed-width non-zero IDs, unique attribution, and row-specific topology.
proof_requirements.codex_status: Codex tool rows require a completed successful tool status and must not contain codex_dynamic_tool_error.
proof_requirements.no_refire: Each allocated row fires exactly once unless a mechanically proven non-fire or explicit group authorization permits replacement.
proof_requirements.folding: Runner output is candidate evidence only; human review must fold authoritative receipts into this corpus.
